data.name: Hirdesh
data.gender_notes: Hirdesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hirdesh is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: Hira (Lord Vishnu) and Desh (domain or path). The name thus means 'Lord Hari's path' or 'the path to Lord Vishnu'. This name is believed to have been used in ancient Hindu texts and scriptures and is associated with devotion, spirituality, and a strong connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_meaning: Following the path of Lord Vishnu.
data.etymology: Hirdesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Hari's path.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hirdesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
